verdict.rationale: Outlook ships Copilot, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows Outlook connecting to MCP servers or using their tools. The Graph mail and notification docs describe APIs that outside apps call, not MCP client support. The one MCP mention describes the reverse direction: an external LLM reaching email through an MCP integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
